current_incident.raw_payload: p99 latency > 2s on payments-api; success rate 91.2% in ID-JKT

historical_incidents.title: KYC vendor rate-limit during Tokopedia flash sale
historical_incidents.symptoms: GrabPay checkout failures spiking in ID region. ERR_KYC_TIMEOUT dominant. kyc-proxy latency 25x normal. No internal deploys.
historical_incidents.root_cause: External KYC vendor (vendor-kyc-id) hit rate-limit during promotional event. Our circuit breaker was mis-configured and did not trip.
historical_incidents.mitigation: Failover to backup KYC provider via: kubectl set env deploy/kyc-proxy KYC_PRIMARY=backup -n payments. Then fixed circuit breaker threshold.

historical_incidents.title: KYC partner unannounced maintenance
historical_incidents.symptoms: Checkout failure rate jumped in Indonesia. KYC upstream returning 503s. No code changes.
historical_incidents.root_cause: KYC vendor performed maintenance without notifying partners. DNS still resolved but endpoint rejected traffic.
historical_incidents.mitigation: Manual failover to backup KYC provider. Added vendor status page scraping for early warning.

historical_incidents.title: KYC retry storm after network blip
historical_incidents.symptoms: Cascading failures in payments after a 30-second network partition. Retry queue grew unbounded.
historical_incidents.root_cause: Retry logic in kyc-proxy had no backoff. After brief network issue resolved, retry storm DDoS'd the vendor.
historical_incidents.mitigation: Added exponential backoff and request deduplication. Bulkhead isolation for KYC calls.

historical_incidents.title: Redis connection pool exhaustion
historical_incidents.symptoms: Payment latency p99 climbed from 200ms to 3s. No error rate change initially. Connections timing out.
historical_incidents.root_cause: Connection pool size was static and hit ceiling during traffic spike. New pod deployments didn't scale pool.
historical_incidents.mitigation: Increased pool size via config map rollout. Added HPA for connection count.

historical_incidents.title: Fraud scoring model deploy regression
historical_incidents.symptoms: Sudden drop in payment approvals across all regions. False-positive fraud flags.
historical_incidents.root_cause: ML model v2.4 deployed with incorrect threshold calibration. Deploy diff was small and missed in review.
historical_incidents.mitigation: Rolled back to v2.3 via feature flag. Re-trained with proper validation set.

historical_incidents.title: Kafka consumer lag on wallet-ledger
historical_incidents.symptoms: Wallet balance updates delayed by 4-12 minutes. User complaints about missing top-ups.
historical_incidents.root_cause: Consumer group rebalance triggered by scaling event never completed. One consumer was stuck.
historical_incidents.mitigation: Force-killed stuck consumer pod, triggered re-election. Added liveness probe.
